name: Ley de Justicia Tributaria (LJT) and its backers (SAR minister Marlon Ochoa, Libre bench)
detail: The consolidated bill text (SAR, 2023) cuts exemptions, restores global income tax and raises the corporate rate; it creates no tax on net wealth. Support for the LJT alone is not support for a wealth tax.

name: 85 international economists' letter backing the LJT (July 2024; Stiglitz, Zucman and others)
detail: Endorses the LJT as an exemptions and evasion reform; the letter does not call for a wealth tax. Zucman's own register entries belong elsewhere.

name: Hugo Noé Pino
detail: Libre vice-president of Congress and economist: 'the one with more income must pay more', defends the LJT; no statement on a tax on wealth found.

name: Rixi Moncada (Libre presidential candidate 2025)
detail: 'El que más tiene, debe pagar más' and a harder LJT; no wealth tax named in the coverage read.

name: COHEP (Rafael Jerez)
detail: Business federation rejecting the 2023 tax reform.
